svg.aria-label: Three zones zooming in. C, 4,096 by 4,096, is cut into 64 by 64 tiles, 1 per block, 4,096 blocks. A block's tile is cut into 16 by 16 patches of 4 by 4, 1 per thread. A thread's patch holds 16 sums, acc[0][0] to acc[3][3], in registers.
svg.text: A block owns a 64 × 64 tile; each of its 256 threads a 4 × 4 patch.
A block of 256 threads owns a 64 × 64 tile of C; thread (tx, ty) owns rows 4ty to 4ty + 3
and columns 4tx to 4tx + 3 of that tile. The shaded thread is tx = 15, ty = 6.
